Kinnikuman - Muscle Generations.name: Kinnikuman: Muscle Generations
Kinnikuman - Muscle Generations.summary: Kinnikuman: Muscle Generations is a Wrestling video game published by Bandai released on February 23rd, 2006 for the PlayStation Portable.

Neverland Card Battles.name: Neverland Card Battles
Neverland Card Battles.summary: Armed with the power to summon allied warriors and creatures, cast powerful spells, and build resourceful bases with his Spectral Cards, guide Galahad on his quest to stop Hellgaia and save the world. The other dominators await, each with their own card-wielding ways. Think you have what it takes to be a true card master? Join the battle and find out.

Puyo Puyo Fever 2.name: Puyo Puyo Fever 2
Puyo Puyo Fever 2.summary: Puyo Puyo Fever 2 is a video game developed by Sonic Team and published by Sega. The game was released as a sequel to the previous title, Puyo Pop Fever. The gameplay remains relatively unchanged, but several new modes are introduced.
